name: Florence
summary: Book the art you most want to see, then connect the centre’s squares and bridges on foot. Sunset views and an Oltrarno meal balance museum time.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are comfortable but busy; summer heat builds in the small historic centre.
arrival: Santa Maria Novella station is walkable to the centre; the airport tram is a practical arrival option.
gettingAround: Walk the core; use a bus or taxi for hills if needed. Avoid bringing a car into restricted central streets.
cashTip: Cards cover most planned spending; carry small EUR notes for market snacks.
foodTip: Try ribollita, schiacciata and Tuscan produce; bistecca is often sold by weight.
buyTip: Compare leather quality, labels and return policies; market price alone does not establish local production.
